highlights.headline: Cost of balancing Great Britain’s power grid reaches nearly £50m a day
highlights.summary: <p>Grid operator paying large sums to switch off windfarms in areas of excess electricity generation while turning on gas plants elsewhere</p><p>The cost of balancing Great Britain’s power grid has soared to near-record highs of almost £50m a day after windfarms were turned off because of bottlenecks in transmitting power around the country.</p><p>The grid operator paid £47.9m on Wednesday to turn windfarms off in areas with an oversupply of electricity and turn gas

items.title: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
items.description: EU leaders meeting in Brussels will examine measures to curb the bloc's huge trade deficit with China. But they will also be looking to further agreement on the next EU budget ahead of some major elections next year.
